name: Wheatland Towne Crossing
summary: Wheatland Towne Crossing is a modern community shopping center strategically located at the intersection of I-20 and US Highway 67 in rapidly growing south Dallas. This family-friendly retail destination offers a diverse range of stores, dining, and entertainment options with convenient access and ample parking for the local community.
demographics: Wheatland Towne Crossing serves the rapidly growing south Dallas community, attracting a diverse, family-oriented demographic with middle-income households. The trade area benefits from its strategic location at the confluence of I-20 and US Highway 67, drawing shoppers from surrounding residential neighborhoods seeking convenient access to everyday retail and dining options. The center caters to value-conscious families and working professionals who prioritize accessibility and a practical mix of essential services and entertainment in one location.
description: Wheatland Towne Crossing is a bustling shopping destination located in the heart of Dallas at 2525 West Wheatland Road, strategically positioned at the confluence of I-20 and US Highway 67 in one of the most sought-after and rapidly growing areas in south Dallas. This modern retail hub features a diverse array of stores, dining options, and entertainment venues designed to cater to the needs of both locals and visitors alike. As part of The Rainier Companies Portfolio, the center offers a family-friendly atmosphere with ample parking and convenient access, making it an ideal destination for everyday shopping needs. The center's location in the vibrant Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex provides shoppers with easy access to a mix of modern attractions while serving the thriving south Dallas community. With high foot traffic and a robust local community, Wheatland Towne Crossing has established itself as a premier location for shopping, dining, and entertainment, offering excellent opportunities for both established and emerging retailers to connect with the diverse Dallas market.
